venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Wednesday 9/2.** Missed target: net $1,191 vs $1,487 target; food $138; 40 guests, $29.79 check avg; comps $62.45. Quiet Wednesday. Opener got the day started; reminder to store garnishes per SOP. Close came in at 6pm and used downtime to detail the wells and clean under the reach-in freezers. Another training day for Victoria; smooth, quiet evening. Kitchen: thanks for detailing the floor. No events, no maintenance needs, no 86s. No incidents. No-shows not charged. Favorite moment: regular Kat stopping in. MOD Mkz/JK. Entered by Mya.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Wednesday 9/2.** Beat target: net $2,105 vs $1,536 target (+37%); event sales $691 (Barbershop Harmony Society team happy hour — ran well, see Kira for details); food $29 (net food and event figures exclude event food); 44 guests, $32.13 check avg; comps $24.30 / 1.1% (employee, industry). Great Wednesday. First guests just after 4:30pm, decent start until event guests arrived ~5:30pm in a large pop — Clay was excellent and John Michael well prepared; Sara stepped out from prep to support. Guests were lovely and pleased; service steady until ~9:30pm, then Thomas and industry folks kept it going past close. Many guests stayed 2+ hours with multiple rounds. Kitchen: John Michael excellent and present on the floor. Maintenance: keg cooler CO2 (possible solution). No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: an energetic Wednesday with lots of first dates going well. MOD KK / Chef JMS. Entered by BC.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Wednesday 9/2.** Beat target including events. DC/AM $1,044.55; D&C PM $5,443.19; Garden/6A $1,643.57; net ex-events $8,237.40 vs $9,796 target; net event sales $5,286 (event food $3,796); total net incl. events $13,523.40; total food incl. events $5,695.76; 149 guests (Tock); comps $264.63 (~3.21%). AM: no report made. PM: very chill and quiet evening with a slight pop at the end; a little rain kept people out of the garden for the last hour of garden service; Madi out ~8:30, host out ~10. Garden: Jordan solo, great flow and vibes. Kitchen (Dante): last-hurrah rush went smoothly, steady garden food all night, great plates by Ayu. Events (Kelly): Air Purification Company meeting + happy hour, 26 guests 10am–6pm; Josh's lunch spread praised; Justice on happy hour, Nik great all day; host and group thanked us on the way out. Maintenance: under-bar lights beneath the marquee won't dim; garden doors sticking on the Mezz floor; VH men's stall door sticking. Break make-up complete. No-shows not charged. No incidents. Entered by Evan.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Wednesday 9/2.** Missed target: net $4,702 vs $5,007 target (−6%); food $368, beverage $4,294, retail $40; 140 covers (Sevenrooms), $34 check avg; comps $89.56. Fairly slow opening on the floor until ~8, which hampered the night, but the following hours were a compelling mix of party sizes and energies. Brief crunch 9–9:30; otherwise seating was smooth. Some side-quest-heavy guests around 11 but the machine ran without hiccups. Coming months will need a faster rhythm to limit waitlists. Cheers to Trent (smooth on a difficult turn) and Max (a couple of three-top checks). 8 solos, 2 large parties, 8 investor cocktails. Top sellers: Paper Wasp, Rosalie, Native Lion. Door (HP): filled gradually, nearly full by 8:15, quieter at 9, packed again at 10 with 30–45 min waits for medium parties; filtered out after 11; misty rain at 12:30 drew a few nightcappers. Hallverd (David's nephew) 8-top birthday; 5 birthdays and 2 anniversaries total; regular/investor Kimberly in as a 6-top; one 8-top where only 3 showed. No-shows: Ostrowski (2, 6:45), Bell (2, 8:15) — not charged. Menu count 18. Breakage: 1 DOF chip. MOD Kyler & Steves. Entered by Thomas.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.weather: Nice and warm, gloomy toward the end
venues.narrative: **LA — Wednesday 9/2.** Just under target: net $4,681 vs $4,855 target (−4%); food $1,054; Marquee $4,681 (Standing Room $0); 135 guests, $35.62 check avg; comps $205.30 (a couple of did-not-likes, birthday gifts, gifts for team Major Domo). Seemed dead at the start, picked up around the 9pm dinner hours; a whole bunch of new guests found us on Instagram. Smooth shift throughout; crew buzzing about staff appreciation day / Medieval Times. Celebrated Mr. Jorge's birthday with snacks. Kitchen: food out at a decent pace; guests loving the oysters and chicken. Low: candles (order more boxes), Echigo lager very low; 86 Siete Leguas reposado. No maintenance. No incidents. No-shows charged. Favorite moment: new server Gracey hustling — looks like a great addition. MOD Julian, Josh & Saleh. Entered by Julian Catano.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Wednesday 9/2.** Beat target: total net incl. events $3,611.92 vs $3,359 target (+8%); Marquee bar sales $3,976.44, Garden $0, total sales $3,976.45; food $419.90; 97 guests (66 walk-in / 31 reso); discounts $38.40 (community members, F&F) plus $69 voids (DNL). Very steady night at the 124 — no major pops, fantastic pacing. Chaz killed it at the door and stepped in to support Devan on the floor; Sasha helped with tables; bar team swung out when possible. Decent food night — James was killing it in the kitchen and even ran plates and touched tables. VIPs: Khaleel and Jordan, photographer Rey Lopez, investor Kim, member Everett. Other side of the night: a leak affecting The Dabney — caused by the back HVAC system (sump pump not working, condensation leaking), not our drains; back AC shut off and office dried; United HVAC returning tomorrow morning; full report in DC Management channel. Incident/injury flagged Yes (see leak report). Maintenance: HVAC, ice machines, curtains. No-shows not charged. MOD Marcus. Entered by Marcus.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Wednesday 9/2.** Beat target: net $4,145 vs $4,000 target (+4%); Municipal Bar AM $1,010 / PM $3,135; Sun Club $73; Hot Eye $0; food $1,972; 100 guests (11 AM + 89 PM, OpenTable); comps $57. AM (Braden): slow, uneventful morning. PM (James & Shan): decent dinner pop 6–9pm with ample staff to field it; no FOH or BOH issues — great shift. Sun Club: very slow start, a little action ~2:30, ~5 drinks sold, no frozens; sluggish by 4:30; needs fruit restock (rotten lemon found), fresh juices, sparkling water, passion fruit. Kitchen: great evening; refired fries for particular guests quickly; 86'd stuffed peppers for good. No events, no maintenance, no incidents. Favorite moment: captured the flag. Entered by James.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Wednesday 9/2. Friends & Family Night 4, the last F&F night (pre-opening; no sales target set; comps $3,763 from 50% F&F discount).** Net $3,722, food $855, 107 guests, $34.78 per guest. Laid-back but busy night; short one server, but Daisey and Tessa held the floor with ease. Finally dialed in the lighting for late-night service and drew the curtains ~9:30. Lots of guest praise; minor note that T21 runs too cold. Setting lighting/sound scenes; need a designated playlist until a curated one is built (local contacts available). Kitchen flew with little trouble, no 86s during service; new dessert went over well; dishes hard to keep up with solo — possible fix via support role. Low/86: cookies, prawns. No maintenance needs, no incidents, no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: the powerful, loving energy of the guests. MOD Curtis Hayes. Entered by Curtis Hayes.
